founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
LinkedIn content for B2B founders, built by founders. 

I have built an audience of 75K+ on LinkedIn and 1.5M+ across Instagram and YouTube - all organically, with 100M+ views and no ad spend.

Now, I’m helping other founders do the same:
→ Scale your presence
→ Drive qualified leads
→ Attract investor interest
→ Hire the right people

We’re in a new era of Go-To-Market. Cold outbound is noisy. Brand is leverage.

And for most B2B founders: LinkedIn is your most powerful GTM channel.
